message: Vector Rebel 3.2.78: preview a verified A/B/C station crew from the approved November 10 assignment source before saving a Captain Set.
releaseNotes: Settings > Captain Sets now includes Preview Crew for a selected station and shift, linked to the private Rebel Command station-crew endpoint. Only exact official Responsible Party identities or administrator-reviewed aliases can populate the draft. Unresolved printed names stay explicitly listed, never guessed. Apply requires captain confirmation, changes only the local draft, and does not save until Save Captain Set is pressed. Regular tour attendance and current leave, OT and swing assignments must still be reviewed. Preserves five-button User interface, 48/96 per-shift tour calendars, automatic error reporting, all prior SCBA queue versions, and no CrewSense writes or PPE submissions.
